description: Defines an interface for pipeline functions with methods for retrieving function name, signature, applying the function, and nested interfaces for signature and parameter definitions.

classes.name: PipelineFunction
classes.description: Interface representing a pipeline function with methods for name, signature, application, and nested signature and parameter definition interfaces.

classes.name: PipelineFunction.Signature
classes.description: Interface for describing a function's signature, including parameter definitions and signature rendering.

classes.name: PipelineFunction.ParameterDefinition
classes.description: Interface for defining a parameter in a function's signature, including name, type, and description.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the pipeline function.

methods.name: getSignature
methods.description: Returns the signature of the pipeline function.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Executes the function with a given value, parameters, and expression resolver, returning a processed result.

methods.name: getParameterDefinitions
methods.description: Returns a list of parameter definitions for the function's signature.

methods.name: renderSignature
methods.description: Renders a string description of the function's signature.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the parameter.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the class type of the parameter.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the parameter.
